analyst_view.overall: Crystal Palace are bottom with 7 points after five straight league defeats, the latest 3-2 at Coventry. Thomas Frank, appointed on 16 November, plays Real Sociedad at home in the Europa League on Thursday night and then this, his first home league game, three days later. Jean-Philippe Mateta (last game of a three-match league ban) and Yeremy Pino (fifth booking) are suspended, Ismaila Sarr is set to miss out again with a groin problem, Riad is out and Tomiyasu could return. Hull are 11th after beating Brighton 2-0, but Tim Iroegbunam (hamstring, four to six weeks) joins Targett, Morita, Matazo, Ansah and Hughes on the sidelines. The numbers already count Pino's ban, Sarr and Iroegbunam as out and Jarred Gillett's card record.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals: 1.0 for Palace and 1.2 for Hull, already taking Pino off Palace (-13%) and Iroegbunam off Hull. Mateta also misses this, but he had scored little this season, so it costs little. A new manager's lift and the Europa League game three days earlier pull in opposite directions, so I stay at about 2.2.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.5 corners, 5.6 for Palace at home, already counting Palace conceding plenty lately and Hull winning more. Frank's first home league game should see Palace push forward, which fits that split, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers expect 4.0 cards, already raised because both sides have been booked more than usual lately, and they count Jarred Gillett's average rate (4.1 a game). It is a tense game for the bottom side, but nothing new points to more, so I stay at about 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers expect 26.4 shots, 16.4 from Palace. Palace play Real Sociedad on Thursday night, three days before, while Hull have had a full week, and the numbers do not count that; Mateta's ban also removes one of their usual shooters. I take about 3% off, to about 25.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers expect 9.2 shots on target, 5.8 for Palace, helped by how many Hull have allowed lately. Palace's tired legs after the Europa League game are not counted, but Pino's ban and Sarr's absence already are, so I make only a small 2% cut, to about 9.0.
